purpose: Express regret or reproach about an unrealized expectation.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
If you had asked sooner, I could have helped.
That coat would be warm; why don’t you wear it?
A single word would have put me at ease.
restrictions: Often follows a hypothetical condition; context supplies the contrast.
mistake: The ending suggests disappointment, rather than neutral prediction.

segments.role: Express regret or reproach about an unrealized expectation. Plain form + だろうに
